runenpfad.title: Runenpfad
runenpfad.loading: Loading the 2D realms and Game Maker sprite packs...
runenpfad.error_assets: The Game Maker 2D sprite or sound packs are currently unreachable.
runenpfad.controls: Move with A/D or arrows, jump with W/Space, strike with J/Enter, dash or slam with K/Shift, heal with Q, pause with P/Esc.
runenpfad.hero_knight_desc: Sturdy guardian with wide sword cleave, projectile parry, and mid-air ground slam (Down + Attack).
runenpfad.hero_ranger_desc: Agile scout with double jump, ranged rune bolts, and evasive dash roll (Shift / K).
runenpfad.upgrade_vitality_desc: Increases your maximum hearts by +1 per rank.
runenpfad.upgrade_might_desc: Increases melee cleave and rune bolt damage.
runenpfad.upgrade_boots_desc: Boosts speed and jump height; rank 4 grants an extra air jump.
runenpfad.upgrade_alchemy_desc: Adds starting healing potions and widens coin magnet range.
runenpfad.lose_body: The runes faded. Regroup and try the stage again.
runenpfad.notice.find_key: Find the Rune Key and reach the Portal.
runenpfad.notice.need_key: The Portal is sealed — claim the Rune Key first.
runenpfad.notice.key_found: Rune Key claimed! Head into the Portal.
runenpfad.notice.boss_defeated: Boss defeated! Claim the Rune Key!
runenpfad.mod_swift_desc: Enemies move 40% faster and have more health.
runenpfad.mod_fragile_desc: Crumbling platforms fall apart much faster.
runenpfad.mod_dark_desc: The light fades; only your rune still glows.
runenpfad.mod_greedy_desc: Coins are worth more, but more enemies lie in wait.
runenpfad.mod_storm_desc: Platforms race by and storm gusts throw you back – listen for the rushing.
runenpfad.mod_mend_desc: More healing potions and hearts in this stage.
runenpfad.notice.seq_watch: The seer stone shows a rune sequence — remember it!
runenpfad.notice.seq_fail: Wrong order — watch the seer stone again.
runenpfad.notice.seq_solved: Rune sequence solved! The vault opens.
runenpfad.notice.lever_hint: Each lever flips some bridge parts — make them all glow.
runenpfad.notice.ritual_hint: Step on the plate, then light the braziers in order — quickly!
runenpfad.notice.ritual_fail: The flames die out — step on the plate to try again.
runenpfad.notice.dragon_warn: A dragon! Take cover under the stone shelters!
runenpfad.notice.swing_hint: Jump onto the rope, swing with left/right, climb with up/down, let go with Space.

runenpfad.npc.alchemist.title: Clockwork Alchemist
runenpfad.npc.end_friend: The covens, the circle and the kobold clans will sing of the rune path walker.
runenpfad.npc.end_neutral: The rune path is quiet again. Few will remember your name.
runenpfad.npc.end_feared: Behind you the clans whisper your name — and lock their doors.
runenpfad.npc.duel.title: Duel!
runenpfad.npc.duel.controls: A/D move · W jump · J strike · ↓ block · K/Shift roll · E rune special
runenpfad.npc.item.potion.name: Healing potion
runenpfad.npc.item.potion.desc: Heals you when you drink it (Q).
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_fire.name: Fire rune
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_fire.desc: Lends you fire power for this stage.
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_frost.name: Frost rune
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_frost.desc: Lends you frost power for this stage.
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_storm.name: Storm rune
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_storm.desc: Lends you storm power for this stage.
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_magnet.name: Magnet rune
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_magnet.desc: Pulls nearby coins and gems to you for this stage.
runenpfad.npc.item.map_charm.name: Map charm
runenpfad.npc.item.map_charm.desc: Shows you the way through this stage.
runenpfad.npc.item.lucky_amulet.name: Lucky amulet
runenpfad.npc.item.lucky_amulet.desc: Coins are worth one more in your next stage.
runenpfad.npc.item.discount_token.name: Discount token
runenpfad.npc.item.discount_token.desc: Takes a little off a later purchase.
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_attune.name: Rune attunement
runenpfad.npc.item.rune_attune.desc: Attunes your runes so they serve you better.
runenpfad.npc.item.glow_mushroom.name: Glow mushroom
runenpfad.npc.item.glow_mushroom.desc: A blue cap that lights the moss at night.
runenpfad.npc.item.sun_shard.name: Sun shard
runenpfad.npc.item.sun_shard.desc: A glinting shard from the dunes.
runenpfad.npc.item.gear_part.name: Gear part
runenpfad.npc.item.hex_charm.name: Hex charm
runenpfad.npc.item.hex_charm.desc: Grimhild's charm. Kobold chiefs respect it.
runenpfad.npc.tip.key_left: The key lies about {count} tiles to the left.
runenpfad.npc.tip.key_right: The key lies about {count} tiles to the right.
runenpfad.npc.tip.key_here: The key is close, or already yours.
runenpfad.npc.tip.key_boss: A guardian holds the key. Defeat it first.
runenpfad.npc.tip.gems_left: {count} gems still glitter here, the nearest to the left.
runenpfad.npc.tip.gems_right: {count} gems still glitter here, the nearest to the right.
runenpfad.npc.tip.secret_left: A wall to the left hides a secret, about {count} tiles away.
runenpfad.npc.tip.secret_right: A wall to the right hides a secret, about {count} tiles away.
runenpfad.npc.tip.secret_none: I sense no secret walls here.
runenpfad.npc.tip.chest_left: A chest waits about {count} tiles to the left.
runenpfad.npc.tip.chest_right: A chest waits about {count} tiles to the right.
runenpfad.npc.tip.puzzle_rune_sequence: Watch the oracle runes closely, then repeat them in the same order.
runenpfad.npc.tip.puzzle_lever_bridge: Pull the lever and the bridge will answer.
runenpfad.npc.tip.puzzle_ritual_chain: Light the ritual stones in the right order, one after another.
runenpfad.npc.tip.boss_boss_boar: The boar charges blindly. Dodge aside and let it slam into the wall, strike while it is dazed, and jump the shock waves of its stomp.
runenpfad.npc.tip.boss_boss_goblin: The goblin chief leaps and hurls spears in high arcs. Watch the red marks on the ground and hit him right after he lands.
runenpfad.npc.tip.boss_boss_orb: The orb’s bullet rings always leave a gap, so slip through it. When the ground glows beneath you, step aside before the beam falls.
runenpfad.npc.tip.boss_boss_quad: When a column on the ground is marked, the quadcopter dives there. Get out, jump its shock wave, and strike while it is low.
runenpfad.npc.tip.boss_boss_mech: The mech’s missiles land on the glowing marks, and its fire strip burns the floor for a few seconds. Keep moving and strike in between.
runenpfad.npc.tip.boss_dragon_frost: The frost dragon breathes along the ground as it flies past. Hide behind the shelters and strike when it swoops low.
runenpfad.npc.witch.hello: Hm! A tin-plated wanderer in my moor. I am Grimhild. My cauldron is cold for want of glow mushrooms, the blue ones that light the moss at night. Bring me three?
runenpfad.npc.witch.reward: A potion that mends three cuts, and the coven's goodwill. Goodwill opens doors, some in caves.
runenpfad.npc.witch.accept: Now that you know to look, you will see them glowing. Three, mind you.
runenpfad.npc.witch.refuse: Then walk carefully. The moor remembers rudeness.
runenpfad.npc.witch.waiting: Still {count} to find. They glow blue near the high ledges.
runenpfad.npc.witch.cold: You again. Here to apologise, or to gawk?
runenpfad.npc.witch.cold.c1: I'm sorry. I'll gather your mushrooms.
runenpfad.npc.witch.turnin: Three glowing caps! The coven owes you, wanderer.
runenpfad.npc.witch.thanks: Take this potion, and a secret: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.witch.friend: My cauldron bubbles again, thanks to you.
runenpfad.npc.witch.won_grudge: Curse your sword arm! The coven will hear of this.
runenpfad.npc.witch.won: Ha! You fight like a thorn bush. Take your prize.
runenpfad.npc.witch.lost: Back to the mud with you. And mind your manners.
runenpfad.npc.witch.ambush: The rude one! The moor remembered, and so do I.
runenpfad.npc.witch.ambush.c2: Wait! Thirty coins, as an apology.
runenpfad.npc.witch.peace: Thirty coins soothe a grudge. Barely.
runenpfad.npc.witch.gift: My favourite mushroom-picker! Krax squats on the next passage. Show him this hex charm.
runenpfad.npc.witch.charm: He will let you pass. Probably.
runenpfad.npc.witch.known: These caves crawl with kobolds; they respect coins and clubs. And their master: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.witch.known.c1: Brew me a hex charm? (25 coins)
runenpfad.npc.witch.wary: You struck me once. I don't forget, but I don't hold grudges forever.
runenpfad.npc.witch.stranger: Another stranger in the dark. Buying or leaving?
runenpfad.npc.witch.sour: You are the one who called my herbs weeds. I have not forgotten.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.hello: Psst, traveller! Fitz has goods, Fitz has prices. Mostly fair ones.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.haggle_ok: Hah! You drive a hard bargain. Fifteen off, this visit only.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.haggle_no: No haggling. Fitz has a family to feed. Probably.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.confront_fake: Ah. The, er, goods. A small misunderstanding, I am sure.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.confront_fake.c1: That was a fake! Pay me back.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.refund: Half back, and not a coin more. Do not tell the other kobolds.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.hello_deep: Down here Fitz sells by candlelight! Torches extra. Everything else, too.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.hello_high: Even up here, Fitz finds you. Cold air, warm prices. Mostly fair.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.wary: Oh. You. Fitz remembers. Watch the scales, and watch your purse.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.forgiven: Twenty coins and a smile. Fitz forgives, a little.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.kobold_tip: Fitz hears Krax likes you. Between friends: Krax loves shiny things, and coins open his gate.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.regular: My favourite customer! Fitz has goods and, for you, news.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.nothing: Nothing new today. If Fitz hears something, you hear it first.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.hello_quest: An errand? Fitz knows a guy who sells what the road will not give.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.hello_quest.c2: What do you have for my errand?
runenpfad.npc.merchant.wares: Mushrooms, shards, gear parts. One at a time, honest prices.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.bought: Pleasure! Genuine goods, no questions asked.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.won: Ow, ow, ow! Fitz is leaving. Business is closed.
runenpfad.npc.merchant.lost: A fair fight, a fair win. No hard feelings. Maybe a few.
runenpfad.npc.chief.respect: Krax remembers your club arm. The way is open, friend.
runenpfad.npc.chief.passed: You already paid. Krax does not forget good coin. Go on through.
runenpfad.npc.chief.friend: Fitz sent word: a friend of kobolds! Krax opens the gate for you.
runenpfad.npc.chief.mercy: Krax is tired of bonking you. Go through. But you owe Krax a favour.
runenpfad.npc.chief.block: Halt, tin wanderer! Krax guards this gate. Pay coins, or taste club.
runenpfad.npc.chief.toll: Forty coins for friends of kobolds. Sixty for everybody else.
runenpfad.npc.chief.paid: Clink, clink! Krax likes your coins. Gate is open.
runenpfad.npc.chief.charmed: A hex charm! Krax hates witch tricks, but a deal is a deal. Gate is open.
runenpfad.npc.chief.won: Krax is beaten! You hit hard. Krax respects hard. Gate is open.
runenpfad.npc.chief.lost: Ha! Small one fights bravely. Krax fights better.
runenpfad.npc.chief.ally: My friend! The cave-whispers tell Krax things: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.chief.gifted: Take it! Krax has more shinies than a dragon.
runenpfad.npc.chief.debt: You owe Krax! Thirty coins, or we bonk again.
runenpfad.npc.chief.grudge: Krax remembers the witch's trick. Fifty coins to forget it, or we bonk.
runenpfad.npc.chief.settled: Debt gone. Krax and tin wanderer are even.
runenpfad.npc.chief.meet: Tin wanderer again! Krax guards the road for Fitz. Buying or leaving?
runenpfad.npc.chief.won_rematch: Krax lost again! Fine, fine. Krax calls you friend now.
runenpfad.npc.chief.lost_rematch: Krax wins! Pay your debt next time, or bring a bigger sword.
runenpfad.npc.seer.hello: The sands told me a wanderer was coming. I am Saida. Fifteen coins and I read the dunes for you. Or do me a favour, and I read them for free.
runenpfad.npc.seer.hello.c1: Read the dunes for me. (15 coins)
runenpfad.npc.seer.hello.c3: Is there a favour I can do instead?
runenpfad.npc.seer.honored: The circle's friends read the dunes for free. Sit, wanderer: the sand is listening.
runenpfad.npc.seer.shun: Wizards' friends pay double here, and the sand has no patience for the rest. Thirty coins, or earn it.
runenpfad.npc.seer.shun.c2: I'll earn it. What do you need?
runenpfad.npc.seer.favour: Three sun shards lie scattered in the dunes ahead, glinting where the mirage ends. Bring them to me and the sand will remember you kindly.
runenpfad.npc.seer.hint: Close your eyes. The dunes say: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.seer.hint.c1: Do you have a riddle for me?
runenpfad.npc.seer.riddle: A riddle, then. I am always ahead of you, never reached; wet to the eye, dry to the tongue. What am I?
runenpfad.npc.seer.riddle_ok: Sharp as a desert hawk! The circle will hear of it. And a gift: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.seer.riddle_no: Not quite. It was a mirage, and you are still walking towards it.
runenpfad.npc.seer.waiting: Still {count} sun shards out there. They glint where the mirage ends.
runenpfad.npc.seer.turnin: Three sun shards! The desert is generous, and so am I.
runenpfad.npc.seer.thanks: Take this magnet rune, and one last sight: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.seer.friend: My friend! The sand sings your name. I sealed a letter for Aldric, the wizard of the glacier tower. It opens his door.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.welcome: Welcome, friend of the circle! I am Aldric. The ice dragons of these peaks fear a few things, and the books know which: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.lore: Runes are older than kings, and they obey patterns. Remember this: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.challenge: A stranger at my tower with no word from the circle? Aldric tests those he does not know. Prove yourself in a duel!
runenpfad.npc.wizard.challenge.c2: Can I earn your trust another way?
runenpfad.npc.wizard.study: Read the stones of this valley, and be kind to the circle's friends. Return when the circle knows your name.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.proven: Well fought! Few hold their ground against Aldric. The circle shall hear of this, and so shall you: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.lost: Study, and return. The circle does not rush, and neither should you.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.gift: You return! Take this frost rune: ice answers those who respect it. And a warning, wanderer: beware the alchemist in the citadel.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.rumour: Brass builds clever machines and keeps cleverer secrets. Ask what the great mech is for. I never got a straight answer.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.known: The ice holds its breath, wanderer. Walk lightly, and watch the citadel.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.cold: The tower is closed to strangers the circle does not know. Come back with proof of good standing.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.cold.c1: A gift to the tower library. (40 coins)
runenpfad.npc.wizard.donated: The library thanks you. Consider the circle's door ajar.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.sabotage_known: You talked with Brass, and it gave up the mech's weak seam? Remarkable. The circle will remember who dared.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.ally: Aldric the Grey greets a friend of the circle! Take this storm rune and a purse: the citadel is no place for empty pockets.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.ally.c1: Any advice on the great mech?
runenpfad.npc.wizard.neutral: The citadel's guardian is a machine of brass and steam. A scholar's note: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.f_honor_seer: Saida's letters, the dunes' favour and the circle's trust: you have earned the tower's full blessing. Take this storm rune and forty coins. The great mech: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.f_honor: The circle speaks well of you. Take forty coins and my blessing. The great mech: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.f_proven: You proved yourself in my own tower, and I do not forget a fair fight. Take fifteen coins and a little luck. The great mech: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.f_fair: The circle does not know you well, wanderer, but the road has been kind to you. A healing potion, then. The great mech: {tip}
runenpfad.npc.wizard.f_cold: You crossed the circle, and the circle remembers. I will not stop you. I will not help you either.
runenpfad.npc.wizard.f_again: Go, wanderer. The mech will not wait, and neither will I.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.hello: Mind the steam! I am Brass: tinkerer, brewer, the citadel's only honest alchemist. I am short of three clockwork gears. Interested?
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.hello.c2: Can you sell me parts instead?
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.wary: Aldric warned you about me, did he? Wizards fear anything with gears. Ask what you like, I have nothing to hide. Mostly.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.accept: Splendid! The gears hide in the high rooms, guarded by clockwork knights. Bring me three and I will make it worth your while.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.parts: Gears are my bread. Twenty coins each, no haggling: the bots never pay me.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.waiting: Still {count} gears missing. Check the high rooms, past the clockwork knights.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.turnin: Three gears, still warm! Brass keeps promises: two discount tokens for the workshop, and my thanks.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.reveal: Between friends: my mech guards the citadel heart. Brass built it, and regrets it a little.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.sabotage: There is a loose seam in its left shoulder plate. One good hit and the mech loses a fifth of its strength. Do not tell Aldric I said so.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.deny: A machine that guards a citadel does not come with a switch. Brass wishes you luck, nothing more.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.known: Back with oil on your sleeves? Browse, browse.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.f_witch: Grimhild sent word ahead: a mushroom-fetcher with true gears. The coven pays its debts. Take forty coins and a potion.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.f_honor: The coven speaks well of you. Take forty coins and a potion, and may the mech be kind.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.f_krax: Krax's runners bring me scrap, and they tell me about a wanderer who dealt with their chief. Here, twenty-five coins and a heart-spring for luck.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.f_cold: Another hero-shaped parcel of trouble. Brass will not stop you, but will not help either.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.f_fair: A traveller without friends, but with a good heart, I hope. Have a potion for the road.
runenpfad.npc.alchemist.f_again: The mech waits. Try not to leave pieces of yourself behind.
